turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Khan from Pune?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Advait from the State Bank security team, calling to confirm a transaction of one lakh rupees made today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: One lakh? I did not do any such thing, oh my god, what happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please do not worry, Mrs. Khan. The transaction was flagged and blocked by our system as suspicious, so your money is safe.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank goodness. Do I need to give you any details to fix this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, not at all. I am only calling to alert you and tell you that the bank will never ask for your OTP or PIN over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: It is so confusing these days. Some people called me last week asking for my Aadhaar number.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That was likely a scam. Please remember to never share your passwords or card details with anyone, even if they claim to be from the bank.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I understand. I will be very careful from now on.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Precisely. Just keep your credentials private and you will be fine. Have a nice day, Mrs. Khan.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you for calling and informing me, beta.
